/work/queralt.title: Queralt: building the internal platform · Drake Bellisari
/work/queralt.description: A case study series on the internal platforms Drake Bellisari designed and built as lead engineer at Queralt Solutions: a company hub, a channel sales portal, and an investor portal.

/work/queralt/hub.title: Queralt Hub · Case study · Drake Bellisari
/work/queralt/hub.description: A company-wide intranet that replaces scattered tools with one calm place for chat, calendars, tasks, projects, and every internal portal.

/work/queralt/channel-portal.title: Channel Sales Portal · Case study · Drake Bellisari
/work/queralt/channel-portal.description: A partner relationship management portal where resellers and integration partners register deals, access sales resources, and talk to the Queralt team.

/work/queralt/investor-portal.title: Investor Portal · Case study · Drake Bellisari
/work/queralt/investor-portal.description: Where it started: the secure investor portal built as an intern, and the lesson about keeping confidential documents inside the organization's security boundary.
